question: Who became the first Indian to win a bronze medal at the Asian Fencing Championships in China in June, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavani Devi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhavani Devi** made history by becoming the **first Indian** to win a **bronze medal** at the **Asian Fencing Championships** held in **China** in **June 2023**.
 
• She achieved this remarkable feat in the **women's sabre event**, showcasing her skill, determination, and commitment to excellence in the sport of fencing.
 
• Bhavani has already gained international recognition, having represented India in various global competitions, including the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
• Her success in the **Asian Championship further solidified her status as a leading fencer from India.**

• **Atanu Das became the first Indian male archer to win a World Cup gold medal in 2015.**
 
• He has **also won several medals in the Archery World Cup and at the Asian Games.**
 
• At the **Tokyo Olympics, he became the first Indian archer to qualify for the round of 16 in the individual event**, showing great resilience and focus.
